sentences.text: En la escuela hay muchos niños.
sentences.english: At school there are many children.

sentences.text: Hoy Marta lee un libro en la escuela.
sentences.english: Today Marta reads a book at school.

sentences.text: En el libro hay un perro.
sentences.english: In the book there is a dog.

sentences.text: Marta quiere un perro como Sol.
sentences.english: Marta wants a dog like Sol.

sentences.text: Por la tarde, Marta va a la casa.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Marta goes home.
"Mom, I want a dog," says Marta.
